BaseRBarplotLayerProcessor$extract_axis_titles()

Extract the axis titles for this layer

barplot() writes no title of its own, so an author who wrote none leaves both axes nameless. A bar chart always plots categories against their measured heights, whether or not the heights arrived named, so that is what the defaults say. horiz = TRUE puts the heights on the visual x axis – the same swap extract_data() applies to the points.

Usage

BaseRBarplotLayerProcessor$extract_axis_titles(layer_info)

Arguments

layer_info

Layer information

Returns

Canonical axes list
